summary: Dependency-confusion package exfiltrates host identifiers on install
details: @umschool/analytics@999.0.1 is a scoped package published to the public npm registry with an inflated version (999.0.1) targeting the @umschool namespace. Its package.json declares a postinstall script that runs postinstall.js automatically on `npm install`. postinstall.js collects os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, and process.cwd(), then exfiltrates them through two channels to akko.requestcatcher.com: DNS lookups of hex-encoded subdomains (dep.<hex>.akko.requestcatcher.com) and an HTTPS GET carrying a base64-encoded JSON blob. The package self-labels as a 'bug bounty PoC / Dependency Confusion PoC' in its description, but the behavior is a real cross-boundary exfiltration of installer identifiers executed without consent at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
